Name: Artisan quality in out
Author: Mister1501
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Artisan Quality In Out[/color][/size][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Artisan Quality In Out[/b] changes the way artisan goods are produced by allowing the final product to inherit the quality of the ingredient used to create it.
In vanilla Stardew Valley, putting a high-quality ingredient into an artisan machine usually results in a normal-quality artisan good. This mod changes that behavior.[/color]

Quality In → Quality Out
The quality of the ingredient is preserved throughout the production process:
[list]
[*]⭐ Normal → Normal [/*]
[*]⭐ Silver → Silver [/*]
[*]⭐ Gold → Gold [/*]
[*]⭐ Iridium → Iridium

For example:
[b]Iridium-quality Ancient Fruit → Iridium-quality Wine[/b]
The resulting product receives the appropriate quality and its corresponding sell value.
 Supported Artisan Goods
The initial version supports:
[list]
[*]Wine [/*]
[*]Juice [/*]
[*]Beer [/*]
[*]Pale Ale [/*]
[*]Mead [/*]
[*]Coffee [/*]
[*]Tea [/*]
[/list]The system is designed to be expandable, allowing additional artisan machines and products to be supported in the future.
 
[list]
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]﻿.[/*]
[/list]
[b]No manual interaction is required.[/b]
Artisan Quality In Out is designed to work with [b]Automate[/b], so you can continue using automated production exactly as you normally would.[/*]
[/list][heading]Version 1.1.2[/heading]
Added
[list]
[*]Added quality inheritance for Preserves Jar products.[/*]
[*]Added quality inheritance for Dehydrator products.[/*]
[*]Added Truffle Oil quality inheritance: Truffle Oil now keeps the quality of the Truffle used.[/*]
[*]Added in-game configuration through Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[*]Added individual toggles for Keg, Preserves Jar, Dehydrator, and Truffle Oil.[/*]
[/list]Changed
[list]
[*]Regular Oil made from Corn, Sunflower, or Sunflower Seeds remains normal quality.[/*]
[*]The mod now uses Stardew Valley's native machine data system, ensuring compatibility with both manual processing and Automate.[/*]
[/list]Fixed
[list]
[*]Fixed Generic Mod Config Menu registration with current GMCM versions.[/*]
[*]Improved compatibility with Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ and SMAPI 4.1.10+.[/*]
[/list]


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

You only need [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
